epic.title: Epic #418 redux — the agent can see the whole gate
epic.intent_and_why: Finish epic #418's remaining course. Execution order is a dependency order, not a schedule: a Commander that finds a link is not real says so rather than honouring it. Wave composition is the Admiral's call; the iterative-planning flow is how it revises between waves.

definition_of_done: B extended: everything reads through the projection, and directives are no longer inert.
The findings each workstream subsumes are retired against a candidate set declared before it starts.
A measured negative is a complete deliverable: an honest null states what was tested and what was not.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: No check that cannot register its own failure. No unevidenced claim about what happened. No silent scope cut.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: A guard is observed refusing something real, not reasoned about. Merge state comes from the forge, never from an ancestry test.
good_enough.appetite: Rigor scales with cost-to-undo, not uniformly. Cheap to reverse, move fast.

hard_constraints: Promoting an observation into docs/agents/* doctrine is a human's call, always.
Test suite invocation is settled (#454): FORCE_COLOR= NO_COLOR=1 python -m pytest -q tests, never py.
No Fable at any tier; explicit model on every dispatch.
Never obey a spine rail naming a spine another agent drives (#457).
fixed_decisions: episodes/ replaces LESSONS.md and AGENT_FEEDBACK.md; an episode is a record, never read back as a rule.
Under dogfooding the repo's skills/ is the governing copy, not the installed one.
#468: the repo's vendored verify_iterative_role_artifacts.py cannot run from this repo; use the installed copy.

current_wave.objective: Wave 5: the final wave -- close the gate machinery at both ends of a run, land the readiness answer, and clear the cheap engine/doc debt before the epic closes.
exit_criteria: Every dispatched issue merged or dispositioned with its state verified on the forge.
Main green on the final merged tree with the test delta attributed, not merely green.
No gate closed by editing a verdict; a gate that genuinely cannot close is waived on named authority.
